delivery_binding.claim_ceiling: Successful request receipt binds visible read bytes; source validation, final selection and semantic use require separate evidence. Archives, tokenizer-only captures and unsuccessful dispatches are not confirmed delivery.

selection.summary: Fix #1241: ensure first input position is valid for a match even on first usage of a context. Root cause lies in ZSTD_window_t initialization/clearing in lib/compress/zstd_compress_internal.h: ZSTD_window_clear (lines ~509-517, h6) sets lowLimit = dictLimit = end based on nextSrc - base, and the base reference is established in ZSTD_window_update (line 671: window->base = ip - distanceFromBase, h13/h0, and surrounding logic h3/h4). When a fresh context starts at offset 0, the reference starts at 0 so index 0 can be treated as a valid match position; starting the reference at 1 (base = ip - 1 style offset) avoids the problematic 0. Callers in lib/compress/zstd_compress.c (h1, h9) establish/reset the window on first use and must also respect the one-based reference.

selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles bound to exact successful request/response, then unchanged native source projection and export; not archive union.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
